english.title: Sell / transfer prohibited ammunition
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without the authority of the Secretary of State, sold or transferred

(A)_[a cartridge with a bullet designed to explode on or immediately before impact]_
(B)_[ammunition containing or designed or adapted to contain any noxious liquid, gas or other thing]_
(C)_[a grenade, bomb or other like missile, or rocket or shell designed to explode on or immediately before impact and which was capable of being used with a firearm]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 5(1)(c) of, and Schedule 6 to, the Firearms Act 1968.

Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure

english.notes:
(i) See also offence wordings: H6105, H6106 and H6107.
(ii) Further offence wording for rockets and ammunition can be found at H1815, H1816, H1817, and H2338.
(iii) On conviction for this offence, the court can order the forfeiture or disposal of any firearm or ammunition and cancellation of any firearm certificate or shot gun certificate, and any firearm or ammunition subject of such order may be seized or detained by a constable (section 52 of the Firearms Act 1968).

other.penalty:
Indictment: maximum 10 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

A minimum sentence may apply to this offence, see section 311 of, and Schedule 20 to, the Sentencing Act 2020.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
